ops.text: The Sprite's drive relay (~/.local/bin/drive) waits on one Orca ask with --wait and loops on timedOut, but never prints the ask's messageId. A relay verb that outlasts Claude Code's background limit (drive pr add, about 40 minutes here while the Mac answered other lanes) is killed with its question still pending, and the lane cannot resume or read that question: it has to type a read verb such as drive status and wait in the same queue again. Printing the messageId to stderr on the first ask, and taking drive --resume <id>, would let a killed relay pick up its own answer.
